'''Cazzush''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] criminal during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Their [[Unidentified criminal gang|gang]] kidnapped the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] [[Prudy]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] after her former [[Marriage/Legends|fiancé]] [[Archiban Frodrick Kimble|Archiban Kimble]], commonly known as Doc, did not deliver the [[Spice/Legends|spice]] that the gang had paid him to.<ref name="Best" />

==Behind the scenes==
Cazzush was originally slated to appear in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in "The Best Intentions," a mission for the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] class' companion character Doc, but was cut before the game's release. The player would have accompanied Doc to Alderaan in order to rescue Prudy, and although the game's conversation files still contain the text for the mission, by the time of the game's release it had been edited so that Doc goes to Alderaan alone but also helps [[Republic Customs Office|Republic Customs]] capture the gang in the process.<ref name="Best" />
